title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a compiler inherits one medical-entry field while rewriting another
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Two adjacent actual antidotary entries give a full first indication list, an explicit backward reference for the second, and different written ingredient lists. Explore a shared entry grammar whose reference selects one field rather than a whole medicine, whole preceding paragraph or freely chosen result. The source provides a concrete omission pattern and a contrasting rewritten field; no Voynich operator is assigned.

source.pointer: Reichenau Antidotarium, Sigerist 1923 p.40; consecutive Acharistum de experimentis coelestini and Acharistum paulini entries
source.read_scope: Both complete institutional source transcriptions, including their headings, prose and ingredient lists. No native image collation.
source.observation: The first entry writes indications and a recipe. The second says Facit ad eadem ad quod supra and writes a different ingredient list. Both use acharistum with different attribution. The reference does not authorize copying every earlier ingredient unchanged.

design.mechanism: A compiling author economizes on one repeated field of an entry while preserving different content in another. Reading this requires a shared schema and selective scope, not treating every previous-text reference as whole-paragraph reuse.

finite_contrast.SELECTIVE_FIELD: One globally selected field is inherited; the other is written anew. The repeated naming base is compatible with distinct qualified entries.
finite_contrast.WHOLE_ENTRY: The entire preceding entry is inherited. Explicit rewritten material requires a separately declared replacement operation and boundary; it cannot silently override arbitrary fields.
finite_contrast.LIST_ONLY: The reference inherits the preceding ingredient list. With no replacement rule this predicts retained list membership, unlike the source's rewritten list.
finite_contrast.CONTENT_ONLY: The expression has no backward dependency. It therefore cannot supply the omitted field in a full interpretation; this rival is not refuted merely by seeing recurrent words.

design.meaning_sensitive_written_prediction: For a candidate whole-account compiler, freeze its field inventory and reference projection before choosing native lexical values. SELECTIVE_FIELD predicts repeated reference construction plus omission of its governed field, with independently unequal written content surviving in the noninherited field. WHOLE_ENTRY plus an override is an explicit rival: if its observable outputs are identical, retain that ambiguity. Do not declare SELECTIVE_FIELD unique merely because its story is shorter.
design.smallest_next_step: Author a finite, inspectable two-entry account over already admitted complete records, jointly hypothesizing their fields and lexical functions. State all omitted and all explicitly replaced content, and use one projection for every occurrence of the candidate construction. A single fixed source-to-writing contract must predict which content is absent and which remains written. If only arbitrary English field names differ, keep the idea raw; do not create a generic reference detector. No target entry is nominated by this card.
design.positive_baseline: Spaces, directed composition, whole-form residuals and context effects are usable structural constraints (608/282/286/318). Known r/l transfer915 and p/y position1073 may constrain realization only after a full candidate is specified; neither is named COPY or INDICATION. New-stem grammar916 remains failed. Source contextual disambiguation1160 does not establish native homography.
predecessors: IDEA895 attempted result-versus-pattern reuse but produced no unequal written consequence in its actual partial account. This raw does not reopen that account. Its source distinction is scope over two explicitly different entry fields, not actual object versus recipe-pattern identity.

IDEA888 table_compilation.json already owns table-header omission across rows. Here an explicit backward reference selects one prose field while another field is rewritten; no table schema, row order or coordinates are presumed.
IDEA747 shares therapeutic effects across botanical variants. It does not supply this written full-field versus omitted-field compilation contrast.
IDEA901 selects an internal textual start. This card selects a semantic entry field, not a literal substring or sung continuation.

GDT1138's missing restrictive consumer, W92's unresolved dictionary-versus-reference account, and fixed-anaphora1153 retain their original limitations. A different historical source alone cannot repair those native accounts.
design.limits: RAW UNREVIEWED. Full word-profile and prior-evidence review is mandatory before any native meaning proposal; none made here. Complete-form frequency and all conflicting occurrences must be retained. Alternate readers are not independent evidence. No source-target lexical match, confirmed plant name, significance or reserve confirmation claimed.
design.access: Existing reports/proposals plus external source transcription only. No target bodies/images, new admission, reserve, experiment or decoder. f84/f84r closed.
